## Combo 1618-2103-6496--97

Requires: Self-Suspending Instant or Sorcery (hand, exile: with time counter(s) on it)

  Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.

Color identity: UR | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 380 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {7} each extra turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Requires: Self-Suspending Instant or Sorcery (hand, exile: with time counter(s) on it)
Start: The Tenth Doctor (battlefield); Taigam, Master Opportunist (battlefield); Expropriate (hand)
Prerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
  You have enough mana to cast Expropriate and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
Steps: Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
  Cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
  Taigam triggers, copying Expropriate and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
  Resolve the copy of Expropriate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Expropriate and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
  Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Expropriate and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
  Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
  Resolve the Expropriate's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
  Repeat from step 3.
Notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

Requires: Self-Suspending Instant or Sorcery (hand, exile: with time counter(s) on it)
Start: The Tenth Doctor (battlefield); Taigam, Master Opportunist (battlefield); Temporal Mastery (hand)

  You have enough mana to cast Temporal Mastery and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.

  Cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
  Taigam triggers, copying Temporal Mastery and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
  Resolve the copy of Temporal Mastery, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Temporal Mastery and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
  Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Temporal Mastery and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
  Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
  Resolve the Temporal Mastery's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
  Repeat from step 3.
Notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

Requires: Self-Suspending Instant or Sorcery (hand, exile: with time counter(s) on it)
Start: The Tenth Doctor (battlefield); Taigam, Master Opportunist (battlefield); Time Warp (hand)
Prerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
  You have enough mana to cast Time Warp and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
Steps: Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
  Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
  Taigam triggers, copying Time Warp and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
  Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Time Warp and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
  Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Time Warp and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
  Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
  Resolve the Time Warp's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
  Repeat from step 3.
Notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

  If you won every flip, instead resolve the card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
  If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before the copying spell ends up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
  Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

Color identity: UR | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{U}{U} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Echocasting Symposium (exile: exiled by its paradigm ability); Capture of Jingzhou (hand); Revolutionist (battlefield)
Steps: Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
  Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist
  When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat.

  An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.

  Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

  Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

  Ral triggers for each copy, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker each time.
  Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
  Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
  Repeat from step 7.

Color identity: UR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat damage; Infinite combat phases; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite death triggers; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite untap of creatures you control
Start: Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to any other creature you control ); Moonblade Shinobi (battlefield); Gimli's Reckless Might (battlefield)
Prerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
  Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
  Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase.
